name: core
las_coeff_note: memo 67 Sec. 2: LAS_core = 0.85*lambda/b_min, from disk-fidelity simulations (90% recovered-flux criterion).

name: spiral
las_coeff_note: PROVISIONAL: memo 67 did not measure Spiral, Mid, or Spiral+Mid (they postdate its analysis). Borrowing the SBA coefficient (0.58, vs. 0.85 for Core) as a conservative stand-in: like the SBA, these subarrays sample their shortest spacings with relatively few antennas/baselines rather than Core's dense, highly-redundant short-spacing coverage, so LAS recovery is expected to be closer to the SBA case than to Core's. Should be replaced with a direct disk-simulation measurement (memo 67 Sec. 2 method) for Rev F Spiral/Mid.
